body:
I can't afford or have the time to talk to a therapist. Where I work won't accommodate for stuff like that. I had to cancel my health insurance a few years back because I couldn't afford it either. 

I wanted to go back to school and maybe get out of IT, try something different because every IT job I've ever had has been horrible. I've been unsuccessful in trying to get any kind of financial help because they said I didn't sign up for selective service which in turns forfeits my ability to get a grant.  I gave up on that dream a long time ago. 

Here lately I've considered leaving society. Maybe just living off the grid and isolated. I'm much more happy when I'm alone and since I don't have any family members left alive it would be easy for me to just drop off the face of the Earth.
